    The representable resolution of a covariant defect #

    For a short exact sequence 0 → A → B → C → 0, the covariant representables form the exact sequence

    0 → Hom(C,-) → Hom(B,-) → Hom(A,-) → G → 0.

    This file splits that resolution into the two short exact sequences used to compute the reverse coherent dual of G.
